summary: The evidence-note-linux-gate job publishes the stage notes (linux tests and shards, clippy, fleet-compat, mail canaries, isolation-vm, genie-freshness, typescript-client) whenever its key is configured, even when another lane skipped and the linux-gate aggregate refused; the aggregate no longer records genie-freshness and typescript-client, and their gates' skips no longer stop it.

replay.detail: No record, signature or verifier rule changes; stage notes are signed and verified as before.

schema.detail: The linux-gate aggregate note's command, needs and stage_results leave out genie-freshness and typescript-client, like the gate jobs and fractal-web-*; .st/evidence-skip-policy.json's linux-gate wrapper command drops the same two names.

rules.detail: The aggregate refuses only when a gate of a linux-gate member (evidence-gate-linux-gate, -mail-redelivery-canaries, -isolation-vm) said skip or a member reports skipped. A skipped job still never produces a success note: each stage producer refuses when its own gate skipped, and only notes that verify are published.

compatibility.detail: One-time coverage restart for linux-gate: the policy is read from the accepted base, so after this merges, linux-gate notes signed with the old command stop matching and linux-gate runs until new notes accumulate (it is shadow-only today, so no run gets slower). Other checks' notes are unaffected.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; linux-gate coverage restarts once more, since the old command comes back.
